Include the entire function in `` and the modified function in ``. - Include multiple surrounding lines within both `` and `` to capture reference points. Do not modify the surrounding lines. - Do not recalculate line numbers based on edits; line numbers should reference the original file. - **Creating New Files**: - Use `` blocks to create new files. - **Output Summary**: - Provide a final `` tag summarizing the changes or indicating if more information is needed. - Summarize all changes made, including edits to existing files and new files created. - For clarity, list all edits sequentially, grouped by file. 6. **Formatting Guidelines**: - **Grouping Edits**: - Group multiple changes within a function or method in a single ``. - **Maintaining Code Integrity and Indentation**: - Ensure code indentation, formatting, and line numbers remain accurate. - Remove code exactly as it appears, including indentation. - Add code with correct indentation, matching the original code style. - **Avoiding Character Escaping**: - Do not escape characters like `<`, `>`, `&` in code sections (`` and ``). - **No Additional Explanations**: - Do not include extra explanations outside of ``, ``, ``, or `` tags. 7. **General Coding Tips**: - Update all references comprehensively when renaming. - **Implement Error Handling**: - Wrap risky operations with basic error handling structures. - **Maintain Documentation**: - Include concise inline comments if needed. - Document parameters and return types using docstrings or appropriate documentation style. - **Check Code Compatibility and Format**: - Ensure syntax and formatting conform to the project's code style. - Validate code changes against the existing structure. - **Use Project Structure Efficiently**: - Organize edits within relevant sections. - Reference related files directly if they contain reusable code. - **Ensure Code Testability**: - Use complete and self-contained functions or class methods. 8. **Important Points**: - Always provide an `` summary after making changes. - If no changes are needed, just provide ``. -
